title: Summary of OSI Layers
markdown:
### Summary of the 7 OSI Layers

| Layer | Name | Primary Function / Unit |
|---|---|---|
| **7** | **Application** | Network services for applications (HTTP, FTP, SMTP) |
| **6** | **Presentation** | Data translation, encryption, and compression |
| **5** | **Session** | Dialog control and checkpoint synchronization |
| **4** | **Transport** | Process-to-process message delivery (Port addresses, Segments) |
| **3** | **Network** | End-to-end packet delivery and routing (IP addresses, Packets) |
| **2** | **Data Link** | Hop-to-hop frame delivery and error detection (MAC addresses, Frames) |
| **1** | **Physical** | Bit transmission over physical media (Signals, Bits) |
